title: EXP-075 - Hello World Part 5 Prerequisite B: Add the Bound FX_Address Property to the FX_HelloWorld01 IDO
objective: Second Address prerequisite for Hello World Part 5 (operator decision 2026-10-13). EXP-074 added the nullable column dbo.FX_HelloWorld01.FX_Address (nvarchar 150, Column Id 11). Using the Web Client IDO Collections runtime Form (titled IDOs) and the EXP-061 route, retrieve exactly the IDO FX_HelloWorld01 (project FX_HelloWorldProject01, base table FX_HelloWorld01, alias fxhw; checked in since EXP-040) and record its identity, revision, checkout state and complete property inventory; prove FX_Address absent. Perform exactly one Check Out of FX_HelloWorld01, then run the New Property wizard once: keep the default Bound type, bind to fxhw.FX_Address, Property Name FX_Address, no property class, Label String ID FX_sAddress if the wizard offers that field; verify the inferred String / nvarchar / 150 type before one Finish. Close and reopen IDO Collections once, verify the inventory equals the baseline plus FX_Address, and confirm the two FX_HelloWorld01 runtime records still load. FX_HelloWorld01 stays checked out. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt1.md Section 6 (Address, String 150, label s Address) and hello-world-pt5.md Sections 1-2, the EXP-074 record (the FX_Address column), the EXP-061 record (IDO Collections query, Check Out without confirmation, New Property wizard pages, Finish without Save), the EXP-071-R2 record (fresh IDOs Form and the criterion captured before F4; read-only criteria after a zero-row query) and the EXP-040 record (FX_HelloWorld01 IDO) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-075-hello-world-part-5-prereq-b-fx-address-ido-property.md and evidence/EXP-075/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Do not touch the Web Designer tab.

Fresh IDOs Form: if the IDOs tab is open and clean, close it once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form; if it is not open, open it once. Check the status bar for Filter in Place before clicking it (EXP-074: a reopened Form can inherit that mode).

Target and baseline: in Filter in Place, type FX_HelloWorld01 into the IDO Name criterion, commit with Tab, capture a screenshot with the criterion visible before F4, press F4 once and establish exactly one FX_HelloWorld01 row. Record project, base table and alias, Revision, Locked By, the Check Out / Check In state and the complete property inventory (expected FX_Code and FX_Label plus the system properties); prove FX_Address absent, case-insensitively.

Check Out: if FX_HelloWorld01 is checked in, invoke Check Out exactly once and record any response and the resulting Locked By and revision; if it is already checked out to the current operator, perform none; if it is locked by another user or ownership is ambiguous, stop.

New Property wizard (once): keep the default Bound type; on the attributes page open the Bind To lookup and select fxhw.FX_Address from the list; set Property Name FX_Address by one plain fill; leave Property Class blank; if the wizard shows a Label String ID field, enter FX_sAddress (commit with Tab), otherwise leave the label unset and record that. Record the Data Type, Length and SQL Column Data Type the wizard shows; continue only if they read String, 150 and nvarchar (or blank fields that inherit from the column, recorded as such). Capture all values before invoking Finish exactly once and record the native response.

After Finish, verify exactly one new property FX_Address (Bound, bound column FX_Address, data type and length as shown, label as set) with the Form clean; perform at most one ordinary toolbar Save only if Finish left the Form dirty.

Close the clean IDOs Form once more and reopen it once more (the recovery pair); run one fresh visible-criterion FX_HelloWorld01 query and compare the recovered identity, checkout state and property inventory with the baseline plus FX_Address.

Runtime check: in the FX_HelloWorld01 runtime Form (already open from EXP-074; otherwise open it once through Form > Open > Select Form) invoke one toolbar Refresh and verify exactly FX001 / Factory test one and FX002 / Factory test two with Save disabled; change nothing.
Capture screenshots of the pre-F4 criteria, the baseline inventory, the checkout result, each wizard page before Finish, the Finish result, the recovered inventory and the runtime rows.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
